quarterly_data.signal: Results release additions to the call: for FY2026 the adjusted gross margin should continue to be in the low-to-mid-forties percentage range, and Free Cash Flow is now expected at around EUR 0.9 billion (previously EUR 1.25 billion), now including the acquisition of the sensor portfolio from ams OSRAM in July 2026; Q4 revenue expected to rise by a good 13 percent. CEO Jochen Hanebeck: power supply solutions for AI data centers 'remain in very high demand and continue to be our most important growth driver'; rising worldwide grid-infrastructure investment provides tailwinds and 'Automotive orders are also picking up noticeably.'
